bullets.text: US Firms Sue Ofcom - **Ofcom** faces legal action from **4chan** and **Kiwi Farms** over alleged free speech violations.
Data Center Workforce Crisis - The **data center** industry struggles with a shortage of skilled tradespeople amid soaring demand.
SK Telecom Fined $97M - **SK Telecom** receives record fine for a massive data breach affecting millions of customers.
Boldyn and VMO2 Launch 5G - **Boldyn Networks** and **VMO2** enhance 5G connectivity at Sunderland’s Stadium of Light.
Global DDoS Attacks Surge - Over 8 million **DDoS** attacks recorded globally in H1 2025 amid rising geopolitical tensions.
Sparkle Expands in Europe - **Sparkle** opens a new Point of Presence in Helsinki to enhance connectivity in Northern Europe.
Leadership for Digital Britain - **NETS International** emphasizes workforce empowerment in the evolving UK telecom landscape.
Nokia Modernizes Rail Connectivity - **Nokia** launches a new 5G radio solution to enhance railway communications globally.
